showcase.problem: Rising complexity and responsibility in BIM coordination under Singapore's Corenet X mandate, which requires fully coordinated BIM models for design gateway submissions. Traditional clash detection generates thousands of unstructured clashes, many false positives or minor errors, overwhelming coordinators and diverting focus from critical design issues.
showcase.proposedSolution: AI-driven solution leveraging Google Gemini 2.0 for advanced clash analysis, using n8n for data processing and PyRevit for Revit integration. The AI filters out low-priority clashes, assigns actionable items to the right disciplines, and provides resolution instructions.
showcase.approach: Integrated workflow using Google Gemini 2.0, n8n for automation, and PyRevit for Revit integration to process and prioritize clash detection results.
showcase.methods: AI-powered filtering and classification of clashes, automated assignment to disciplines, intelligent resolution recommendations.
showcase.tools: Google Gemini 2.0, n8n, PyRevit, Navisworks, Revit
showcase.impact: Substantial reductions in irrelevant clashes, faster processing, improved accuracy in identifying high-impact issues, accelerated feedback loops, cost savings, and more efficient design resolution. Future plans include platform-agnostic tools and automated reporting.

showcase.problem: Unstructured and poorly classified BIM components disrupt downstream workflows and reduce digital coordination credibility. SketchUp models contain thousands of objects from various sources lacking proper IFC classification, metadata, or layer assignment, leading to delays, errors, and significant manual cleanup.
showcase.proposedSolution: SketchUp plugin integrated with agentic AI workflow: TensorFlow for visual recognition, GPT-4o for initial classification and metadata, GPT-o3-mini for validation and reasoning, and GPT-4o-mini for clean BIM data output.
showcase.approach: Multi-stage AI pipeline combining computer vision and language models for intelligent classification and validation.
showcase.methods: Visual recognition using TensorFlow, AI-powered classification and metadata assignment, validation through reasoning models, automated BIM data structuring.
showcase.impact: 95% classification accuracy, 18 seconds average processing per object, dramatic reduction in manual workload, ensures compliance and collaboration readiness, raises overall productivity. Next steps include user-supplied API keys and Revit compatibility.

showcase.problem: Current generative design tools in Rhino-Grasshopper demand extensive human input, making the process labor-intensive and limiting creative exploration. Core challenges include extracting rich geometric information from images, deploying LLM agents to interact with parametric scripts, and generating accurate GhPython code for complex design tasks.
showcase.proposedSolution: Proof of concept exploring how LLMs and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) can automate geometry extraction, code generation, and iterative design refinement in Rhino-Grasshopper environment.
showcase.approach: Investigating LLM agents to interact with parametric scripts, potentially leveraging RAG for improved accuracy in automated design workflows.
showcase.methods: Automated geometry extraction from images, AI-powered GhPython code generation, iterative design refinement through LLM agents.
showcase.impact: Highlights potential to make computational design faster, more accessible, and intuitive. Future development focuses on expanding input methods, refining prompts, introducing specialized geometry agents, and integrating with ETABS and Revit.

showcase.problem: Manual site inspections and report generation in construction are inefficient and risky. Site teams spend hours recording defects, cross-referencing codes, and compiling reports, leading to delays, errors, and commercial risks.
showcase.proposedSolution: Telegram-based AI chatbot powered by OpenAI GPT-4.1, enabling users to input unstructured data (images, text, voice) during site walks. AI processes data, cross-references regulatory codes using RAG, assesses defect severity, and generates standardized inspection reports.
showcase.approach: Mobile-first chatbot interface integrated with AI processing pipeline and regulatory knowledge base through RAG.
showcase.methods: Multimodal input processing (images, text, voice), RAG-based code compliance checking, automated defect severity assessment, standardized report generation.
showcase.impact: 5X productivity boost, reducing report generation from 150 to 30 minutes, 80% accuracy in compliance checks. Frees professionals for higher-value tasks, improves report quality and code compliance, serves as learning tool. Planned enhancements include expanded code coverage, plan drawing integration, and real-time rectification tracking.
